target: Implement Phase 2 P2-01 Frame + Rule primitives for the Cockpit core: a width-locked three-column character grid at 120x40, 100x32, and 80x24, with fail-closed blocker behavior below 80x24.

pr.title: feat(cockpit): add frame rule primitives
pr.body:
## Summary
- add Cockpit Frame and Rule primitives for the approved 120x40, 100x32, and 80x24 character grids
- enforce protected border/divider/rule cells and whole-character-cell drawing
- return the existing fail-closed blocker string below 80x24

## Strict scope
- primitive geometry only
- no replacement of render_pm
- no mode dispatch changes
- no live data wiring
- no runtime action execution

## Validation
See closeout proof for command outputs and exit codes.

steps.task: Inspect D3 Frame/Rule primitive requirements and current render.py viewport behavior.
validation: The implementation uses the existing viewport contract from render.py.
No parallel PM renderer is introduced.
The approved grid coordinates for 120x40, 100x32, and 80x24 are recorded.

steps.task: Implement primitive-level FrameLayout, FrameBuffer, protected rule cells, and frame shell rendering.
validation: Three approved frame sizes render exact line width and count.
Outer border, column dividers, body rule, status rule, and bottom rule cells are protected.
Below 80x24 returns the canonical blocker string.

steps.task: Add focused tests for grid coordinates, width locks, protected writes, and blocker behavior.
validation: Cockpit unit slice passes or known unrelated failures are reported.
No runtime execution, upload, or live data wiring is added.

steps.task: Run brand audits, relevant tests, proof hash validation, codereview/precommit, commit, push, and open PR.
validation: brand_lint exits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
PR URL or exact blocker is recorded in proof and final closeout.
